- Fix IndexError on out-of-range heater levels in Tesla Fleet ([@sebr] - [#178049]) ([tesla_fleet docs])
- Deduplicate sleepers within a single SleepIQ bed ([@derekcentrico] - [#181461]) ([sleepiq docs])
- Handle Enphase envoy Session is Closed in background tasks ([@catsmanac] - [#183172]) ([enphase_envoy docs])
- Treat MPD protocol errors as a connection failure ([@mattias-arrelid] - [#184481]) ([mpd docs])
- Bump py-opendisplay to 7.18.1 ([@g4bri3lDev] - [#184911]) ([opendisplay docs]) (dependency)
- Bump aiotankerkoenig to 0.5.5 ([@mib1185] - [#185714]) ([tankerkoenig docs]) (dependency)
- Tankerkoenig handle api errors config flow ([@mib1185] - [#185719]) ([tankerkoenig docs])
- Handle Gemini generation parameters and complete WAV TTS responses ([@oohhddaanngg] - [#185723]) ([google_generative_ai_conversation docs])
- Fix SmartTub error sensor reporting stale historical errors ([@mdz] - [#185726]) ([smarttub docs])
- Bump aiohttp to 3.14.5 ([@bdraco] - [#185746]) (dependency)
- Mark Aquacell sensors unavailable when data is stale ([@alexborro] - [#185762]) ([aquacell docs])
- Bump aionanoleaf2 to 1.0.5 ([@feixm1] - [#185777]) ([nanoleaf docs]) (dependency)
- Bump my-pv to 0.0.13 ([@rrooggiieerr] - [#185797]) ([my_pv docs]) (dependency)
- Catch TimeoutError in the Nettigo Air Monitor integration ([@bieniu] - [#185812]) ([nam docs])
- Ignore devices without TR-064 support during FRITZ!Box Tools SSDP discovery ([@mib1185] - [#185816]) ([fritz docs])
- Bump arcam-fmj to 3.0.1 ([@elupus] - [#185887]) ([arcam_fmj docs]) (dependency)
- Handle Alexa RequireRelink on cloud entity registry updates ([@balloob] - [#185894]) ([cloud docs])
- Redact schedule coordinates in Teslemetry and Tesla Fleet diagnostics ([@Bre77] - [#185905]) ([teslemetry docs]) ([tesla_fleet docs])
- Report a dedicated error when the Tedee bridge has no locks ([@zweckj] - [#185907]) ([tedee docs])
- Prevent WiiM browse failures from marking devices unavailable ([@Linkplay2020] - [#185926]) ([wiim docs])
- Fix group sensor crash when the group has no members ([@joostlek] - [#185931]) ([group docs])
- Do not cut off KNX SQLite telegram store initialization with a timeout ([@farmio] - [#185940]) ([knx docs])
- Bump nyt_games to 1.0.1 ([@joostlek] - [#185968]) ([nyt_games docs]) (dependency)
- Gate Nanoleaf event listener on supports_events ([@loebi-ch] - [#185977]) ([nanoleaf docs])
- Fix MQTT device triggers and tags firing twice after reload ([@klejejs] - [#185998]) ([mqtt docs])
- Fix FRITZ!SmartHome SSDP host selection ([@mib1185] - [#186029]) ([fritzbox docs])
- switch Broadlink to broadlink-async (fixes #184800, replaces #184806) ([@DAB-LABS] - [#186053]) ([broadlink docs])
- Fix weatherflow last_reset updating on every device report ([@jeeftor] - [#186141]) ([weatherflow docs])
- Bump weatherflow4py to 1.5.12 ([@jeeftor] - [#186142]) ([weatherflow_cloud docs]) (dependency)
- Bump intellifire4py to 4.5.6 ([@jeeftor] - [#186143]) ([intellifire docs]) (dependency)
- Fix scrape subentry reconfigure flow not finishing ([@joostlek] - [#186144]) ([scrape docs])
- pin pycares to 5.0.1 ([@aclerici38] - [#186164])
- Allow a list of states for state conditions with a duration ([@emontnemery] - [#186165])
- Bump airthings-ble to 1.3.1 ([@LaStrada] - [#186387]) ([airthings_ble docs]) (dependency)
- Guard owner and existing credentials in auth provider create command ([@zweckj] - [#186398]) ([config docs])
- Fetch missing Renault vehicle details ([@epenet] - [#186402]) ([renault docs])
- Fix Discogs random record sensor when release has no format description ([@cerealkiller57540] - [#186405]) ([discogs docs])
- Fix permissions validation for ProxmoxVE ([@CoMPaTech] - [#186420]) ([proxmoxve docs])
- Hide MELCloud Home swing modes on units without vanes ([@erwindouna] - [#186468]) ([melcloud_home docs])
- Fix modbus reload without YAML config ([@joyjit] - [#186554]) ([modbus docs])
- Revoke refresh tokens when removing a user ([@frenck] - [#186558])
- Redact credentials and host in SFR Box diagnostics ([@epenet] - [#186668]) ([sfr_box docs])
- Fix SolarEdge module statistics sum resetting after a gap ([@tronikos] - [#186753]) ([solaredge docs])
- Bump deebot-client to 18.7.0 ([@edenhaus] - [#186779]) ([ecovacs docs]) (dependency)
- Redact identifying data in NRGkick diagnostics ([@andijakl] - [#186781]) ([nrgkick docs])
- Persist Ecovacs account credentials to avoid device verification ([@erwindouna] - [#186796]) ([ecovacs docs])
- Update frontend to 20260930.4 ([@bramkragten] - [#186813]) ([frontend docs]) (dependency)
- Fix Fritz setup failing when UPnP info lacks NewEnable key ([@mib1185] - [#186896]) ([fritz docs])
- Bump aiomelcloudhome to 0.3.0 ([@erwindouna] - [#185769]) ([melcloud_home docs]) (dependency)
- Pin pypasser below 1.0.0 ([@erwindouna] - [#186527])
